text:
maria_cs: Quick sync — NimbusAI accepted the Dedicated pool offer. Confirmed quota: 24xA100, 1.2M tokens/day baseline, burst to 3M. Need warmup plan + load test window. Who can own schedule?

jordan_se: I can take scheduling. Would like a 48h warmup then 4h 75% burst soak, then 2h 100% burst smoke. Works for the team?

leo_sre: Sounds good. We should gate on autoscale policy first. Current default policy won't scale past 80% for priorities. Recommend policy: `scale_up_policy: aggressive-burst`, `min_instances: 6`, `max_instances: 30`.

alex_oncall: FYI we'll need a temporary override for their quota validation job — it spikes KV cache build. Add `kv_cache_prepopulate: true` to the warmup plan. Otherwise we'll see token spike failures.

maria_cs: Noted. @olivia_pm can you confirm customer availability next week? They asked for a narrow window (Mon-Tue).

olivia_pm: NimbusAI confirmed Mon 09:00-17:00 PST for warmup, Tue 02:00-08:00 PST for burst smoke. They prefer minimal ops chat during smoke but want an after-action at +2h.

jordan_se: OK locking in Mon warmup 09-17, Tue smoke 02-06 (we'll keep extra 2h as buffer). I'll post the runbook link and owners.

maria_cs: Owners: Jordan = schedule & customer comms, Leo = infra & autoscale tuning, Alex = oncall escalation, DevOps = scripts/run commands.

devops_bot: deploy-plan created: `nimbusai-dedicated-warmup-v1` — runbook: https://rwd-internal/ops/runbooks/nimbusai-warmup (edit rights: jordan_se, leo_sre) :white_check_mark: 

jordan_se: Pasting minimal run commands for the load generator (for ops):
```
# warmup profile (gradual)
./loadgen --profile warmup --qps 200 --duration 8h --prefix-cache true
# smoke (burst)
./loadgen --profile burst --qps 1200 --duration 4h --headers "x-customer=nimbusai"
```

leo_sre: Couple of tuning notes: 1) Set batching max_tokens to 512 for cold KV cache, 2) enable prefix cache TTL=48h for their prep jobs, 3) monitor `inflight_tokens` > 50k alert. I'll push a tuning patch to the pool config.

alex_oncall: I'll create an ephemeral escalation channel and set pager rotations for Tue 01:30-08:30 PST. If we see >1% 5xx on the model route, auto-fallback to smaller model variant `bert-lite-quant` is enabled.

maria_cs: Good. Risk callouts: renewal sensitivity if SLA blips during bring-up. Jordan please capture a minimal customer Q&A deck about expected latencies and fallbacks.

jordan_se: Will do. I'll have the deck ready by EOD Fri and put it in the runbook.

olivia_pm: NimbusAI also asked for post-warmup feedback capture — they want a short survey + scheduled 30m enablement session. I'll draft the survey.

maria_cs: Great. Action items summary: Jordan = schedule & deck, Leo = autoscale + alerts, Alex = oncall rota + fallback, Olivia = survey + enablement invite, DevOps = load scripts. Everyone: please react with :thumbsup: once set.

leo_sre: :thumbsup:

jordan_se: :thumbsup:

alex_oncall: :thumbsup:

olivia_pm: :thumbsup:

maria_cs: Thanks team — I'll run the AOR with NimbusAI tomorrow morning and confirm final hostnames.
